annotations.text:
Pick'em redesign, 2026-09-11.
Matches the League Dashboard / Game Center island: Barlow Condensed display, Archivo body, dash-* tokens, 14px card radius, 10px tile radius, 9px button radius.
Slate is the real Week 1 2026 scoreboard. League picks, my picks, confidences and standings are SAMPLE values.
Click a team on the desktop or phone board to pick it. Tweaks above each board switch light/dark and confidence/straight.
Rulings 2026-09-11: league picks reveal at lock only (a count before), Line and forecast reuse existing snapshots, no 'insight' or 'rank' vocabulary.
Phone: teams stack into rows, the confidence chip moves down beside the pick count, and the save bar sticks to the bottom with the progress meter.

Server change: five nullable columns and one JSON column on the live game row, written by the hourly Line Sync run and the 30 s clock poll. The week endpoint exposes them as separate optional fields. The client never calls ESPN.
